title: Configure keeps values that no longer exist
body:
**Bug: What is the current behavior?**

- Pass { insideBoundingBox } to Configure
- Remove it and pass only { aroundLatLng }
- Configure is put into the url twice: 

```
"&configure[insideBoundingBox]=42.0095169,-114.131211,32.528832,-124.482003&configure[aroundLatLng]=33.7489954,-84.3879824"
```

I expect if there's no props on configure, the values will be removed from the search state :) 

**What project are you opening an issue for?**
- react-instantsearch

**What is the version you are using? Always use the latest one before opening a bug issue.**

3.1.0
